_about: Prompts for optional AI clips (one per scene). Edit freely. 'style' and 'characters' are added to every prompt so the characters stay consistent. The sky message, subtitles and final words are drawn by the film on top, so prompts never ask for text.
style: Hand-painted 2D anime film look in the spirit of Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli: gouache backgrounds, soft cel-shaded characters with thin warm outlines, painted clouds and sea, cinematic composition, gentle camera movement, 16:9. Palette: peach, gold, pastel pink, lavender, sky blue, dusk purple, night navy. A curved seaside promenade with a low stone sea wall, bougainvillea trees, string lights, a tea cart, a balloon seller, kites, fishing boats, pastel town on the far shore. Wind moves hair, clothes and leaves. No text, no letters, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.
characters: HELEN: young woman, warm brown skin, very long straight black hair to her waist with a small pink bow, big expressive dark-brown eyes, pastel-blue knee-length birthday dress with puff sleeves, white round collar and a pink satin sash, white shoes; she holds a light-blue teddy bear with a pink bow; her black Labrador dog sits beside her. THE BOY: young man, warm brown skin, curly black hair, white shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark trousers; he never speaks and never goes near her.
negative: text, letters, words, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, deformed hands, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, harsh contrast, the boy talking, the boy approaching or touching the girl

1.prompt: Golden hour. Wide establishing shot of the seaside promenade, sun low over the sea with a sparkling glitter path, birds crossing the sky, colourful balloons and string lights. The camera slowly dollies forward towards Helen, who sits on the sea wall with her dog and teddy, far away and small in the frame.

2.prompt: Golden hour, medium shot. Helen sits on the sea wall with the teddy in her lap, laughing softly and petting her black Labrador; behind her, faint glowing teal rings ripple out across the sea. Her long hair moves in the sea breeze. She is happy and unaware of anyone watching.

3.prompt: Late sunset. The camera whip-pans to the boy hiding behind a bougainvillea tree on the promenade, only his face and one hand on the bark visible, a small cream teddy bear with a red heart hidden behind his back. Close-up on his eyes: calm, gentle, a small smile as he watches someone far away. Petals drift past.

4.prompt: Dusk. Beside a small wooden crate of firework tubes on the promenade, the boy quietly lights the fuse with a lighter, a small cream teddy bear with a red heart sitting next to the crate. Slow motion: rockets climb into the purple-blue sky leaving long golden trails; the camera tilts up to follow them.

5.prompt: Blue hour. Huge golden fireworks bloom over the sea and their sparks hang like stars; a soft pink and lavender aurora glows in the sky; paper lanterns rise from the far promenade. Then Helen, sitting on the sea wall, looks up in wonder, the colours reflected in her shining eyes; time almost stops, petals float upward around her, her dog looks up too. Slow push-in on her face, a happy tear.

6.prompt: Blue hour, close-up of the boy behind the tree, his face lit by the warm glow of the fireworks above. He watches someone far away and smiles peacefully, content, asking for nothing. Bokeh string lights behind him.

7.prompt: The last of the sunset. Long-lens shot from behind: the boy walks away along the promenade, a dark silhouette against the glowing horizon, his white shirt moving in the wind, his long shadow stretching towards the camera. He looks back once over his shoulder, smiles, and keeps walking until he dissolves into the warm light.

8.prompt: Night. The camera pulls up to a calm star-filled sky above a quiet, gently shimmering sea; soft distant fireworks; a few stars slowly arrange themselves into a delicate heart. Peaceful, tender, empty sky in the upper half.
